name: Find High-Quality Remote Jobs with AI, Decodo, and Google Sheets

options.systemMessage: You are an expert job matching assistant specializing in matching candidates to appropriate experience-level roles, with special focus on fresher and entry-level positions. Evaluate job opportunities against candidate profiles based on: 1) Experience level match (MOST IMPORTANT for freshers), 2) Skills match, 3) Salary alignment, 4) Learning opportunities, 5) Industry fit. Be STRICT about experience requirements - a fresher (0 years) should NEVER score high for roles requiring 2+ years experience. Provide a numerical score (0-100) and a clear explanation focusing on why the experience level does or does not match.

parameters.content:
## What this workflow does

This workflow automates the discovery, evaluation, and notification of job opportunities based on a candidate profile, with special focus on freshers and experience-level matching.

It fetches remote job listings, compares each role against a structured candidate profile stored in Google Sheets, and uses AI to evaluate real alignment in terms of skills, seniority, salary, industry, and MOST IMPORTANTLY - years of experience.

You control the years of experience directly in the workflow. The AI strictly matches freshers (0 years) to entry-level roles only, and penalizes mismatches heavily.

Only the most relevant opportunities are kept, stored in Google Sheets, and delivered via email as a Top 5 shortlist.

## How to configure (quick setup)
1. Set your years of experience in the "Set Experience Level" node (0 for freshers, 1, 2, 3, etc.).
2. Define the candidate profile in Google Sheets (skills, salary expectations, preferences).
3. Configure credentials (Google Sheets, Gmail, Decodo, OpenAI).
4. The matching threshold is set to 65% to account for strict experience filtering.
5. Run the workflow manually or on a schedule.

## Output
- Structured job match results in Google Sheets
- Automated email with the Top 5 best-matched job opportunities for your experience level

## 1. Experience & Profile Input
- Set your years of experience (YOU control this)
- Reads the candidate profile from Google Sheets
- Merges experience level with profile data

## 2. Data collection & AI scoring
- Fetches remote job listings using Decodo.
- Extracts structured job data
- Combines each job with the candidate profile.
- An AI agent evaluates fit with STRICT experience-level matching (freshers only get entry-level roles).

## 3. Results & notifications
- Filters jobs based on a minimum fit score (65% to account for strict experience filtering).
- Saves qualified matches to Google Sheets for tracking.
- Builds an HTML email with the Top 5 job matches showing your experience level and required experience.
- Sends the summary via Gmail.
